item.title: Lead Data Scientist, Marketplace Intelligence & Optimization - Comcast (CC) of Willow Grove
item.description:
Universal Ads, a part of Comcast, enables any brand, of any size, to seamlessly make and buy commercials across premium video reaching new qualified audiences at scale. Universal Ads combines premium and brand-safe video content directly from the most influential media companies with the ease and familiarity of social ad buying. It is your one-stop shop for high-quality video ads delivering performance and unmatched scale.
**Job Summary**
We're looking for an experienced Lead Data Scientist to build marketplace intelligence across Universal Ads, uncovering opportunities to improve supply efficiency, delivery performance, and marketplace growth. You'll work closely with Product, Publisher Partnerships, and Engineering to analyze the full advertising supply funnel, diagnose constraints and auction inefficiencies, and quantify opportunities to unlock incremental inventory, advertiser spend, and performance. Your insights will directly inform publisher strategy, supply investments, and product optimization priorities.
The ideal candidate combines deep analytical and modeling expertise with a strong understanding of programmatic advertising, auction dynamics, and marketplace economics. This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on role with significant influence over Universal Ads' supply strategy, optimization roadmap, and marketplace growth.
**Job Description**
**Responsibilities:**
* Analyze and build performance monitoring for our end-to-end advertising supply funnel, from available inventory and bid eligibility through auction wins, delivered impressions, and advertiser outcomes. * Identify and quantify marketplace inefficiencies, including publisher restrictions, creative eligibility, deal configurations, auction competition, pricing floors, and drivers of campaign delivery. * Partner with product to develop predictive models and analytical frameworks to identify delivery risks and opportunities to improve bidding, pacing, and inventory allocation. * Develop supply and reach forecasting models to estimate inventory availability, campaign delivery capacity, and potential advertiser spend. * Partner with Publisher Partnerships to identify high-value inventory, evaluate supply-demand gaps, and quantify the incremental revenue and performance potential of new publishers, markets, and supply integrations. * Establish marketplace health metrics to monitor supply utilization, auction efficiency, delivery performance, and emerging growth opportunities. * Translate complex analyses into actionable recommendations that inform product optimization priorities, publisher investments, and marketplace strategy.
**Employees at all levels are expected to:**
* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job. * Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services. * Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences. * Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas. * Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers. * Drive results and growth. * Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead. * Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

Big Data, Data Analysis, Predictive Modeling, Statistical Analysis Techniques, Statistical Methods

item.title: Applied Scientist, Search Ranking and Exploration - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
Amazon's Search team creates ML algorithms that connect customers around the world with products that delight them. We harness machine learning at Amazon's scale to make the customer experience easier and smoother. Our impact is large. For example, if your innovations save even 1 minute per customer per year, then for every 100 million customers, you save approximately 190 years of human effort.
Key job responsibilities As an Applied Scientist on the Search L1 Ranking team, you will build search ranking models that work for thousands of product types, billions of queries, and hundreds of millions of customers spread around the world. You will find the next set of big improvements to ranking, leverage large datasets to understand the complexities of customer behavior, and build ML models that work at Amazon scale. Amazon's Search ranking relies on efficient early stage ranking followed by power final stage ranking models. this role focuses on efficient models for early stage ranking phase, and techniques to personalize these models and optimize them automatically.
A day in the life Our primary focus is improving search ranking systems. On a day-to-day this means building ML models, analyzing data from your recent A/B tests, and collaborating with partner teams on joint goals. We leverage agentic workflows to improve our scientific velocity, and partner closely with SDEs to bring our ideas to production. You will shape the future of search ranking by presenting proposals to Amazon's business and tech leaders.
About the team We are a team consisting of ML scientists and software engineers. Our interests span machine learned ranking models, distilled LLMs for efficient inference, personalization techniques to refine the ranking of our models, reinforcement learning to bring the benefits of exploration to search ranking, and infrastructure to make it all happen at scale and efficiently.

* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

* Experience using Unix/Linux * Experience in professional software development

item.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketplace Economics - Roblox
item.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic and causal insights that power pricing, market health, and creator success across all Economy surfaces.
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.
Why Marketplace Economics?
* **Real-world scale:** Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users. * **Complex markets, rich signals:** Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response. * **Strategic ownership:** Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions on the economics of our Marketplace. * **Impact meets innovation:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.
You will:
* **Design Economic Systems**: Drive the structural design of creator and curator incentives, including formulating revenue-share models that foster a thriving, balanced ecosystem. * **Master Pricing & Supply Response**: Architect models that evaluate price elasticity, marketplace clearing rates, and predict how creators (supply) respond to pricing shifts and new economic policies. * **Spearhead UGC Category Launches**: Lead the quantitative strategy for introducing new User-Generated Content (UGC) categories, establishing the foundational economics and incentive structures needed to spark market liquidity. * **Apply Deep Causal Inference**: Build rigorous observational and experimental causal inference solutions to isolate the true impact of market interventions on creator success and platform economics. * **Drive Strategy**: Partner with product and engineering leaders as a primary scientific advocate, providing unbiased measurement and insights to accelerate innovation and strategic prioritization.
You have (at least some of) the following:
* **6+ years** of industry or research experience in Data Science or Economics, specifically within large-scale UGC content platforms, pricing, marketplace mechanism design, or creator economies. * **Deep Methodological Expertise** in quantitative methodologies, causal inference (observational and experimental), and modern data stack tools (Python, R, SQL), alongside a deep theoretical understanding of econometrics and mechanism design. * **Marketplace Intuition** with a proven track record of working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behavior and isolate its impact on long-term outcomes and platform health. * **Executive Communication & Leadership** skills to distill high-dimensional economic problems into succinct, actionable narratives for non-technical executive audiences. * **An Advanced Degree** (Master's or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

You are a systems thinker and a deep collaborator who can initiate and facilitate challenging technical decisions across multiple teams. * **An Advanced Degree** (Master's or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.
We're hiring a Senior Data Scientist to drive the product analytics and experimentation strategy for AppFolio's Resident experience business. You'll help elevate the renter experience and protect millions of people by driving growth across our resident-facing offerings—including **FolioGuard renters' insurance, resident rewards programs, and comprehensive resident benefit packages**. item.title: Senior Staff Data Scientist, Product Data Science (Mailchimp) - Intuit
item.description:
**Overview** ------------
The Mailchimp Product Data Science team turns product and customer data into insights and models that shape Mailchimp's product strategy. We work as thought partners with Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Pricing to drive data-driven decisions through experimentation, causal measurement, and deep customer analytics.
We're looking for a Senior Staff Data Scientist to be an analytical leader for Mailchimp's product growth. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you'll set the measurement vision across the full customer journey: sign-up and onboarding, activation, conversion to paid, engagement, and long-term retention. The role raises the scientific bar for how we experiment and size opportunities, and it shapes product and business strategy at the senior leadership level. It's also hands-on, focused on the highest-leverage problems and on helping the team adopt AI-native workflows that let us move faster.
This role is based in New York, NY / Mountain View, CA / Atlanta, GA under Intuit's hybrid model, 3 days per week in office.
**Responsibilities**
* **Influence product strategy:** Be a strategic thought partner to senior Product and business leaders. Shape Mailchimp's growth roadmap with deep dives into customer segmentation, onboarding and activation funnels, feature adoption, pricing and packaging, and retention. * **Set the analytics vision:** Own the measurement framework, north-star and guardrail metrics, and leading indicators for the self-serve customer journey, from free and trial sign-ups to paid conversion, bookings, and recurring revenue. * **Lead experimentation and causal measurement:** Drive a culture of rigorous, iterative experimentation. Design complex tests (A/B/n, sequential, holdouts, long-running), apply Bayesian and frequentist inference, and use causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, and synthetic control where randomized tests aren't possible. * **Size and prioritize opportunities:** Build opportunity-sizing and forecasting frameworks that turn product initiatives into incremental revenue impact, accounting for retention curves and the winner's curse, so leadership can prioritize investment. * **Uncover growth opportunities:** Use first-principles thinking and exploratory analysis to find untapped levers across the funnel, including in-product onboarding, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and plan upgrades. * **Shape the AI-native roadmap:** Partner with Product and Engineering to measure AI-powered features in Mailchimp. Build ML and LLM-based solutions such as propensity models, personalization, and automated insights for hard product problems. * **Raise the scientific bar:** Build reusable analytical frameworks, governed metric definitions, and self-serve tools that improve decision-making at scale. Champion strong instrumentation and data quality. * **Lead and mentor:** Be a technical lead for the Product Data Science team. Coach and grow senior and staff data scientists, review their methods, and model executive-ready storytelling.
**Qualifications**
* 8+ years in data science, product analytics, or a related field, with a proven record of driving product strategy and measurable business impact. * Experience in B2B SaaS, subscription, or freemium/self-serve businesses strongly preferred. Familiarity with marketing technology or small-business customers is a plus. * Expert SQL and data modeling skills on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery preferred), plus advanced Python or R. * Deep expertise in experimental design and causal inference, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor against speed of decision-making. * Track record of sizing opportunities and forecasting revenue impact, including funnel, cohort, and retention analysis. * Hands-on experience applying machine learning (classification, regression, uplift or propensity modeling) and LLM/GenAI workflows to real product problems. * Proficient in an AI-native data science tech stack (for example, Claude, Cursor, or Codex with MCPs, CLIs, and APIs) and eager to keep building how the team works with AI. * Excellent executive communication. You turn complex analysis into clear narratives and recommendations, and you've influenced senior leaders across Product, Marketing, and Finance. * Experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional work where the question, metric definitions, or methodology have to be set before the analysis can start. * Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership of other data scientists. * Bachelor's or graduate degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Operations Research, or equivalent practical experience.
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.
The expected base pay range for this position is:
New York $210,500 - $284,500

item.title: Sr. Data Scientist, Assay Development - Delfi Diagnostics
item.description:
**About Us**
DELFI Diagnostics, Inc. (DELFI Diagnostics) is developing next-generation, blood-based tests that are reliable, accessible and deliver a new way to help detect cancer. Employing advanced machine-learning methods to whole-genome sequencing data, the DELFI ("DNA EvaLuation of Fragments for early Interception") platform is built to address the highest-burden health challenges. DELFI Diagnostics prioritizes solutions that have the potential to save lives on a global scale, including for historically underserved populations. DELFI Diagnostics’ platform relies on fragmentomics – the discovery that cancer cells are more chaotic than normal cells and, when they die, leave behind tell-tale patterns and characteristics of cell-free DNA (cfDNA) fragments. FirstLook Lung, for individuals eligible for lung cancer screening, is DELFI Diagnostics’ first laboratory-developed screening test and can be part of routine blood work. FirstLook Lung uses millions of data points to reliably identify individuals who may have cancer detected through low-dose CT, including early stage disease with a negative predictive value of 99.8 percent. This test has not been cleared or approved by the FDA.
In our passionate pursuit to radically improve health outcomes, we serve humanity when we:
**Lead with Science, Anchor in Pragmatism**: We pioneer life-changing science by ensuring quality, transparency, and rigor at all times. We explore thoughtfully, experiment smartly, and deliver impact with conviction.
**Build With & For All**: We embrace diverse backgrounds to innovate and achieve together. We are not just building a product - we aim to disrupt the path of cancer for all - no matter geography or socioeconomic class
**Put We over I**: We are a home for high-performing people. Through teamwork, we build collective intelligence. Each of us wins when those we serve and those who serve with us-win. We show up with empathy, humility, and integrity at every step of the journey.
**DELFI has 1-2 designated in-office working days each week for employees who live within within 50 miles of Palo Alto, CA**
### **About the Role**
The Senior Data Scientist will partner with assay development, lab operations, quality, regulatory, and software teams to support DELFI’s LDT and IVD early cancer detection assays as they move from late development into commercial use. The role focuses on study design and data analysis that keep our products performing reliably, including performance monitoring frameworks, change impact assessments, and bridging studies for LDT updates, as well as supporting verification and transfer to production. As products evolve, this person will also contribute to assay development work. The ideal candidate brings strong statistical foundations, experience in regulated diagnostics, and the ability to work independently across the later stages of the product lifecycle.
### **What You'll Do**
* Design studies and analyze data to evaluate assay performance and inform product decisions. * Develop statistical methods for production monitoring and for qualifying reagents, controls, and instruments across LDT and IVD products. * Assess the impact of reagent, instrument, software, and process changes, and design and analyze bridging studies for LDT updates. * Support verification and transfer to production for LDT and IVD products, including defining acceptance criteria. * Support regulatory submissions (CLIA/CAP, NYS, FDA as applicable) with rigorous, well-documented analyses. * Lead data analysis for troubleshooting, investigations, and root cause analysis, and contribute to assay development as products evolve. * Produce well-documented code (Python preferred, R acceptable) that meets quality system and software team standards.
### **What You'll Bring**
Required
* Master’s degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Applied Math, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; PhD preferred. * Five or more years of experience in scientific data analysis, including at least three years in Python or R (Python preferred). * Strong foundations in probability theory and statistics, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, parameter estimation, equivalence testing, and variance components. * Experience in a regulated diagnostics environment (IVD, LDT, or similar), including designing, analyzing, and documenting verification, validation, or change assessment studies. * Demonstrated ability to independently lead study design and analysis with cross-functional teams. * Ability to connect assay chemistry to data behavior to troubleshoot performance issues. * Familiarity with Design of Experiments and related quality methods (statistical process control, measurement systems analysis, Six Sigma/DMAIC).
Preferred
* Experience supporting launched assays, including production monitoring, lot qualification, or post-market changes. * Experience supporting assay transfer from development into production or a clinical laboratory. * Exposure to NGS-based assays, including sequencing QC and batch variability. * Familiarity with FDA design controls and IVD submissions.
$130,000 - $170,000 a year
Actual base pay will consider experience, skillset, education, and geography.
This role may be eligible for other forms of compensation, including an annual bonus and a new hire equity grant, subject to the terms of the applicable plans and Company discretion. All employees are also eligible for DELFI's comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including but not limited to: a flexible time-off policy; a 401(k) retirement plan; an extremely competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage; onsite lunch 3 days a week; and other wellness related offerings.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
